local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local RING_SPEED   = 0.35
local PLANET_SPEED = 0.16
local PORTAL_SPEED = 0.22

local rigs = {}
local dirty = {}
local base = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local clock = 0

local function baseOf(p)
	local cf = base[p]
	if not cf then
		cf = p.CFrame
		base[p] = cf
	end
	return cf
end

local function centroid(parts)
	local sum = Vector3.zero
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do sum += baseOf(p).Position end
	return sum / #parts
end

local function planeNormal(parts, c)
	local v1 = (baseOf(parts[1]).Position - c)
	if v1.Magnitude < 1e-4 then v1 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
	v1 = v1.Unit
	local best, bestMag = nil, 0
	for i = 2, #parts do
		local v = baseOf(parts[i]).Position - c
		if v.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
			local cr = v1:Cross(v.Unit)
			if cr.Magnitude > bestMag then best, bestMag = cr, cr.Magnitude end
		end
	end
	if not best or bestMag < 1e-3 then return Vector3.yAxis end
	return best.Unit
end

local function snapshot(parts)
	local t = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do table.insert(t, {part = p, cf = baseOf(p)}) end
	return t
end

local function collect(model, ringMatch, bodyMatch, ringSpeed, bodySpeed)
	local ring, body = {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local n = d.Name:lower()
			if n:find(ringMatch, 1, true) then table.insert(ring, d)
			elseif bodyMatch and n:find(bodyMatch, 1, true) then table.insert(body, d) end
		end
	end
	if #ring < 3 then return end
	local c = centroid(ring)
	local axis = planeNormal(ring, c)
	local rig = {
		ringPivot = c, axis = axis, ring = snapshot(ring),
		ringSpeed = ringSpeed, bodySpeed = bodySpeed,
	}
	if #body > 0 then
		rig.bodyPivot = centroid(body)
		rig.body = snapshot(body)
	end
	return rig
end

local function build(m)
	rigs[m] = nil
	if not m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	if m.Name == "RingedPlanet" then
		rigs[m] = collect(m, "ring_block", "planet", RING_SPEED, PLANET_SPEED)
	elseif m.Name == "Portal" then
		rigs[m] = collect(m, "ring_segment", nil, PORTAL_SPEED, 0)
	end
end

local function isRig(m)
	return m and m:IsA("Model") and (m.Name == "RingedPlanet" or m.Name == "Portal")
end

local function mark(d)
	if isRig(d) then
		dirty[d] = true
	elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
		local m = d:FindFirstAncestor("RingedPlanet") or d:FindFirstAncestor("Portal")
		if isRig(m) then dirty[m] = true end
	end
end

local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld"):WaitForChild("Zones")
for _, d in ipairs(zones:GetDescendants()) do mark(d) end
zones.DescendantAdded:Connect(mark)
zones.DescendantRemoving:Connect(mark)

local function spin(parts, pivot, axis, angle)
	local r = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, angle)
	local toWorld = CFrame.new(pivot) * r * CFrame.new(-pivot)
	local stale = false
	for _, e in ipairs(parts) do
		if e.part.Parent then
			e.part.CFrame = toWorld * e.cf
		else
			stale = true
		end
	end
	return stale
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	clock += dt
	for m in pairs(dirty) do
		dirty[m] = nil
		build(m)
	end
	for m, rig in pairs(rigs) do
		if m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			local stale = spin(rig.ring, rig.ringPivot, rig.axis, clock * rig.ringSpeed)
			if rig.body and spin(rig.body, rig.bodyPivot, rig.axis, clock * rig.bodySpeed) then
				stale = true
			end
			if stale then dirty[m] = true end
		else
			rigs[m] = nil
		end
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local BEHIND = 4
local AHEAD = 4
local EVERY = 0.5

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local zonesFolder = map:WaitForChild("Zones")

local park = Instance.new("Folder")
park.Name = "ParkedDecor"
park.Parent = RS

local homes = {}
for _, z in ipairs(zonesFolder:GetChildren()) do
	local n = tonumber(z.Name:match("^Zone(%d+)_"))
	if n then homes[n] = z end
end

local parked = {}
local lastCentre = 0

local function apply(centre)
	for n, zone in pairs(homes) do
		local want = n >= centre - BEHIND and n <= centre + AHEAD
		if want then
			local m = parked[n]
			if m then
				if m.Parent == park then m.Parent = zone end
				parked[n] = nil
			end
		else
			local m = zone:FindFirstChild("Decor")
			if m then
				parked[n] = m
				m.Parent = park
			end
		end
	end
end

local function centreOf(root)
	local ok, n = pcall(Cfg.zoneAt, root.Position.Z)
	if ok and type(n) == "number" then lastCentre = n end
	return lastCentre
end

local function parkLibrary()
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	if lib then lib.Parent = RS end
end
workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child.Name == "AnimalLibrary" then task.defer(parkLibrary) end
end)
parkLibrary()

while true do
	local ch = plr.Character
	local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		apply(centreOf(root))
	end
	task.wait(EVERY)
end

local function lum(c)
    return 0.299 * c.R + 0.587 * c.G + 0.114 * c.B
end

local function layer(parent, name, inset, colour, radius, z)

    f.Name = name

    f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    f.Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2)
    f.BackgroundColor3 = colour
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.Active = false
    f.ZIndex = z
    f.Parent = parent
    corner(f, radius)
    return f
end

local function paintTile(face, look)
    local rimColour = look.rim or look.bottom:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45)
    if lum(rimColour) > lum(look.bottom) * 0.72 then
        rimColour = look.bottom:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.4)
    end
    local border = face:FindFirstChild("TileBorder")
    if not border then
        border = layer(face, "TileBorder", 0, TILE_INK, 14, 6)
        local rimLayer = layer(border, "TileRim", 2, rimColour, 12, 6)
        local fill = layer(rimLayer, "TileFill", 2, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 10, 6)
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        grad.Rotation = 90
        grad.Parent = fill
        local studs = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        studs.Name = "Studs"
        studs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        studs.Active = false
        studs.Image = ICON.studs
        studs.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
        studs.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13)
        studs.ImageTransparency = 0.3
        studs.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        studs.ZIndex = 7
        studs.Parent = fill
        corner(studs, 10)
    end
    local rimLayer = border.TileRim
    rimLayer.BackgroundColor3 = rimColour
    rimLayer.TileFill.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(look.top, look.bottom)
    return rimLayer.TileFill
end

local function shadeTile(face, top, bottom)
    face.TileBorder.TileRim.TileFill.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom)
end

local wantedEggs = {}

local function eggSig(tool)
    local z, t, s = tool:GetAttribute("EggZone"), tool:GetAttribute("EggTier"), tool:GetAttribute("EggSize")
    if not (z and t and s) then return nil end
    return ("z%d_t%d_s%d"):format(z, t, s)
end

local function eggToolsBySig()
    local by = {}
    for _, holder in ipairs({ plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), plr.Character }) do
        for _, t in ipairs(holder and holder:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") and not keyOf(t) then
                local sig = eggSig(t)
                if sig then
                    by[sig] = by[sig] or {}
                    table.insert(by[sig], t)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return by
end

local function reconcileEggs()
    local by = eggToolsBySig()
    local ready = os.clock() >= bagReadyAt
    for sig, tools in pairs(by) do
        local want = wantedEggs[sig] or 0
        local have = 0
        for _, t in ipairs(tools) do if stored[t] then have += 1 end end
        for _, t in ipairs(tools) do
            if have >= want then break end
            if not stored[t] and t.Parent ~= plr.Character then
                stored[t] = true
                have += 1
            end
        end
        if ready and have ~= want then
            wantedEggs[sig] = (have > 0) and have or nil
            Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { sig = sig, count = have })
        end
    end
    if ready then
        for sig in pairs(wantedEggs) do
            if not by[sig] then
                wantedEggs[sig] = nil
                Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { sig = sig, count = 0 })
            end
        end
    end
end

local function setStored(tool, on)
    if not tool or tool:GetAttribute("Gear") then return end
    stored[tool] = on or nil
    local k = keyOf(tool)
    if k then storedKeys[k] = on or nil end
    if on and tool.Parent == plr.Character then
        local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:UnequipTools() end
    end

    if k then
        Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { key = k, on = on == true })
    else
        local sig = eggSig(tool)
        if sig then
            local n = 0
            for _, t in ipairs(eggToolsBySig()[sig] or {}) do
                if stored[t] then n += 1 end
            end
            wantedEggs[sig] = (n > 0) and n or nil
            Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { sig = sig, count = n })
        end
    end
    if markDirty then markDirty() end
end

local function toolsOfPlayer()
    local list = {}
    local function scan(parent)
        for _, t in ipairs(parent and parent:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then
                local gear = t:GetAttribute("Gear")
                local zone = t:GetAttribute("EggZone")

                local pet = t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone")
                if gear or zone or pet then
                    table.insert(list, {
                        tool = t,
                        gear = gear,
                        pet = pet ~= nil,
                        zone = zone or pet,
                        tier = t:GetAttribute("EggTier") or t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1,
                        size = t:GetAttribute("EggSize") or t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1,
                        equipped = (t.Parent == plr.Character),
                        stored = isStored(t),
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    scan(plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
    scan(plr.Character)
    table.sort(list, function(p, q)
        if (p.gear ~= nil) ~= (q.gear ~= nil) then return p.gear ~= nil end
        if p.gear then
            return (GEAR_ORDER[p.gear] or 9) < (GEAR_ORDER[q.gear] or 9)
        end
        if p.tier ~= q.tier then return p.tier > q.tier end
        if p.size ~= q.size then return p.size > q.size end
        if p.zone ~= q.zone then return p.zone < q.zone end
        return p.tool.Name < q.tool.Name
    end)
    return list
end

local function inside(obj, pos)
    if not obj.Visible then return false end
    local p, s = obj.AbsolutePosition, obj.AbsoluteSize
    return pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + s.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
end

local function slotAt(pos)
    for i, e in ipairs(hotSlots) do
        if inside(e.slot, pos) then return i end
    end
end

local function paintTargets(hover)
    for i, e in ipairs(hotSlots) do
        local equipped = e.tool ~= nil and e.tool.Parent == plr.Character
        e.stroke.Transparency = (i == hover or equipped) and 0 or 1
    end
end

local function beginDrag(tool, from, fromSlot, button, input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    suppressClick[button] = nil
    drag = { tool = tool, from = from, fromSlot = fromSlot, button = button,
             start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), active = false }
end

local function moveDrag(pos)
    if not drag then return end
    if not drag.active then
        if (pos - drag.start).Magnitude < DRAG_START or carryingEgg() or not drag.tool.Parent then return end
        drag.active = true
        suppressClick[drag.button] = true
        grid.ScrollingEnabled = false
        local side = hotSlots[1].slot.AbsoluteSize.X
        if side <= 0 then side = 60 end
        ghost.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(side, side)
        fillIcon(ghostView, drag.tool)
        ghost.Visible = true
        markDirty()
    end
    ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X - ghost.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, pos.Y - ghost.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2)
    paintTargets(slotAt(pos))
end

local function placeInSlot(tool, from, fromSlot, target)
    local other = hotSlots[target].tool
    if other and other ~= tool then
        if from == "bar" then
            pinned[other] = fromSlot
        else
            pinned[other] = nil
            if not other:GetAttribute("Gear") then setStored(other, true) end
        end
    end
    pinned[tool] = target
    if from == "card" and isStored(tool) then setStored(tool, false) end
end
local function placeInBag(tool, from)
    if from == "bar" and not tool:GetAttribute("Gear") then
        pinned[tool] = nil
        setStored(tool, true)
    end
end
local function endDrag(pos)
    local d = drag
    drag = nil
    if not (d and d.active) then return end
    ghost.Visible = false
    iconToken[ghostView] = (iconToken[ghostView] or 0) + 1
    ghostView:ClearAllChildren()
    grid.ScrollingEnabled = true
    local tool = d.tool
    if tool.Parent then
        local target = slotAt(pos)
        if target then
            placeInSlot(tool, d.from, d.fromSlot, target)
        elseif d.from == "bar" and panel.Visible and inside(panel, pos) then
            placeInBag(tool, d.from)
        end
    end
    markDirty()
end

local function relayout()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local small = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) < 500
    local pw = math.floor(vp.X * (small and 0.55 or PANEL_W_SCALE))
    local ph = math.floor(vp.Y * (small and 0.52 or PANEL_H_SCALE))

    local slot = math.floor(((math.floor(vp.X * PANEL_W_SCALE) - (SLOTS - 1) * SLOT_GAP) / SLOTS) * 1.56)
    if small then slot = math.max(slot, math.floor(math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.15)) end
    local touchGui = plr.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    local jump = touchGui and touchGui.Enabled and touchGui:FindFirstChild("JumpButton", true)
    if jump and jump.Visible and jump.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
        local room = (jump.AbsolutePosition.X - 8) * 2 - vp.X
        local fit = math.floor((room - (SLOTS - 1) * SLOT_GAP) / SLOTS)
        if fit >= 36 then slot = math.min(slot, fit) end
    end
    layout.slot = slot
    for _, e in ipairs(hotSlots) do

        e.numC.MaxTextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(slot * 0.21))

renderPanel = function()
    for name, t in pairs(tabButtons) do
        t.stroke.Color = PICKED
        t.stroke.Transparency = (name == activeTab) and 0 or 1
        t.button.BackgroundTransparency = (name == activeTab) and 0.02 or 0.12
    end

    local all = toolsOfPlayer()

    local needle = search.Text:lower():gsub("[^%w%s]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local rows = {}

    for _, row in ipairs(all) do
        local mine = activeTab == nil or ((activeTab == "Pets") and row.pet) or (activeTab == "Eggs" and not row.pet)
        if not row.gear and mine
           and (needle == "" or row.tool.Name:lower():find(needle, 1, true)) then
            table.insert(rows, row)
        end
    end

    local grew = false
    for index = 1, math.max(#rows, #cards) do
        local row = rows[index]
        local c = cards[index]
        if row and not c then
            c = makeCard(index)
            cards[index] = c
            grew = true
        end
        if c then
            if row then
                c.card.Visible = true
                c.tool = row.tool
                if c.shown ~= row.tool then
                    c.shown = row.tool
                    fillIcon(c.view, row.tool)
                end
                local ink = TIER_INK[row.tier] or INK

                c.name.Text = row.tool:GetAttribute("Species")
                    or Cfg.NAMES[row.zone] or ("Zone " .. tostring(row.zone))
                c.name.TextColor3 = ink
                local sz = Cfg.SIZES[row.size]
                c.sub.Text = sz and ("(" .. sz.name .. ")") or ""
                c.sub.TextColor3 = ink
                c.star.Visible = row.equipped == true

                c.card.BackgroundColor3 = row.stored and c.baseBg
                    or c.baseBg:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(64, 170, 80), 0.45)
                c.stroke.Color = PICKED
                c.stroke.Transparency = row.equipped and 0 or 1
            else
                c.card.Visible = false
                c.tool = nil
                c.shown = nil
            end
        end
    end
    if grew then relayout() end

    if #rows == 0 then
        if needle ~= "" then
            empty.Text = "No results"
        else
            empty.Text = (activeTab == "Pets") and "No pets yet"
                or (activeTab == "Eggs") and "No eggs yet - steal one and bring it home"
                or "No items yet - steal an egg and bring it home"
        end
    else
        empty.Text = ""
    end
end

local function paintCount(entry)

    if type(n) ~= "number" then
        entry.count.Text = ""
        return
    end
    entry.count.Text = "x" .. n

local function renderBar()

    local list = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(toolsOfPlayer()) do
        if row.gear or not row.stored or row.equipped then table.insert(list, row) end
    end
    local bySlot, loose = {}, {}
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do
        local want = pinned[row.tool]
        if want and not bySlot[want] then bySlot[want] = row else table.insert(loose, row) end
    end
    local nextLoose, lastUsed = 1, 0
    for i = 1, SLOTS do
        if not bySlot[i] and loose[nextLoose] then
            bySlot[i] = loose[nextLoose]
            nextLoose += 1
        end
        if bySlot[i] then lastUsed = i end
    end
    for i = 1, SLOTS do
        local row = bySlot[i]
        local e = hotSlots[i]
        if row then
            e.tool = row.tool
            e.slot.Visible = true
            paintCount(e)
            if e.shown ~= row.tool then
                e.shown = row.tool
                fillIcon(e.view, row.tool)
            end
            e.stroke.Color = PICKED
            e.stroke.Transparency = row.equipped and 0 or 1
            e.slot.BackgroundTransparency = row.equipped and 0.05 or 0.25
        else

            e.tool = nil
            e.shown = nil
            e.count.Text = ""
            iconToken[e.view] = (iconToken[e.view] or 0) + 1
            e.view:ClearAllChildren()
            e.stroke.Transparency = 1

refresh = function()
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        if chosen[i] and not owned(chosen[i]) then chosen[i] = nil end
    end
    local count, sizes, ref = 0, {}, nil
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        local s, t = slots[i], chosen[i]
        if t then
            count += 1
            ref = ref or t
            table.insert(sizes, t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1)
            s.title.Text = t:GetAttribute("Species") or t.Name
            s.title.TextColor3 = tierColour(t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier"))

            s.title.Text = "Empty"

            s.add.Visible = true
            s.remove.Visible = false
            s.view.Visible = false
            if s.shown then
                s.shown = nil
                s.view:ClearAllChildren()
            end
        end
    end

    holoCount(count)

    local left = Fuse.SLOTS - count
    if left > 0 then
        state.cost = 0
        setFuseText((left == 1 and "%d Pet Left" or "%d Pets Left"):format(left))
        setFuseTone(K.ready)
        info.Text = ("Egg size and Luck (%d%% to +%d%%) are random"):format(Fuse.LUCK_MIN, Fuse.LUCK_MAX)
    else
        local zone, tier = ref:GetAttribute("AnimalZone"), ref:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1
        local cost = 0
        for _, sz in ipairs(sizes) do cost += Fuse.cost(zone, tier, sz) end
        cost = math.floor(cost / #sizes + 0.5)
        state.cost = cost
        setFuseText("FUSE " .. money(cost))
        setFuseTone(coins() >= cost and K.ready or K.close)
        info.Text = ("You get a %s egg - random size, Luck %d%% to +%d%%"):format(
            tostring(ref:GetAttribute("Species") or "pet"), Fuse.LUCK_MIN, Fuse.LUCK_MAX)
    end
end

            local done = (total and total > 0) and (1 - left / total) or 0
            r.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(done, 0.03, 1), 1)
            r.clock.Text = Cfg.fmtTime(left)

    end

local function pair(c)
	local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
	if s < 0.15 then
		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(176, 204, 255)
	end
	if h > 0.45 and h < 0.75 then
		return Color3.fromHSV(0.53, 0.30, 1), Color3.fromHSV(0.61, 0.85, 0.95)
	end
	local top = Color3.fromHSV((h + 0.045) % 1, s * 0.8, math.min(1, v * 1.1 + 0.12))
	local bottom = Color3.fromHSV((h - 0.06) % 1, math.min(1, s * 1.1 + 0.08), v * 0.86)
	return top, bottom
end

local function paint(label, g)
	local base = label.TextColor3
	if base == WHITE and label:GetAttribute("HoloBase") then
		return
	end
	label:SetAttribute("HoloBase", base)
	local top, bottom = pair(base)
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom)
	label.TextColor3 = WHITE
end

local function wanted(label)

		or label:FindFirstAncestor("ZoneSign") ~= nil
end

local function dress(label)
	if dressed[label] or not label.Parent then return end
	if not wanted(label) then return end
	local g = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if g and g.Name ~= GRADIENT then return end
	if not g then
		g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		g.Name = GRADIENT
		g.Rotation = 90
		g.Parent = label
	end
	local was = label:GetAttribute("HoloBase")
	if typeof(was) == "Color3" and label.TextColor3 == WHITE then
		label.TextColor3 = was
	end
	dressed[label] = true
	paint(label, g)
	label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(function()
		if label.TextColor3 ~= WHITE then paint(label, g) end
	end)
end

local function measure(pen)

            hi = hi:Max(p.Position + p.Size / 2)
        end
    end
    rects[pen] = {
        minX = lo.X + FENCE_INSET, maxX = hi.X - FENCE_INSET,
        minZ = lo.Z + FENCE_INSET, maxZ = hi.Z - FENCE_INSET,

end

local function flyToMe(info)
    local zone = tonumber(info.zone) or 1

    local lib = (workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary") or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary"))
    for _ = 1, 100 do
        if lib then break end
        task.wait(0.2)
        lib = (workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary") or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary"))
    end
    local folder = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. zone)
    if not folder then return end
    local list = folder:GetChildren()
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
    if #list == 0 then return end

    local tier = tonumber(info.tier) or 1
    local size = tonumber(info.size) or 1
    local idx = (tier >= 3) and (6 + (tier - 2)) or math.clamp(size, 1, 6)

    local pick = (info.species and folder:FindFirstChild(info.species)) or list[((idx - 1) % #list) + 1]
    if not pick then return end

    local m = pick:Clone()
    pcall(Paint.paint, m, tier)
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CastShadow = false
        end
    end
    local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
    local want = 2.2
    if math.max(box.X, box.Y, box.Z) > 0.01 then
        m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (want / math.max(box.X, box.Y, box.Z)))
    end

    local from = Vector3.new(info.x or 0, (info.y or 0) + 1, info.z or 0)
    m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(from))
    m.Parent = workspace

    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = os.clock()
        local DUR = 0.85
        while os.clock() - t0 < DUR do
            local ch = plr.Character
            local head = ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("Head") or ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            if not (head and m.Parent) then break end
            local k = (os.clock() - t0) / DUR
            local ease = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)

            local target = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
            local pos = from:Lerp(target, ease) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(k * math.pi) * 2.2, 0)
            m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, k * math.pi * 3, 0))
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        if m.Parent then m:Destroy() end
    end)
end

            if p.n % 30 == 0 then
                local boxCf, boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
                p.gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, boxCf.Position.Y + boxSize.Y / 2 - model.PrimaryPart.Position.Y + 1.6, 0)
            end
            local left = (model:GetAttribute("HatchAt") or 0) - now
            local ready = left <= 0
            local text = ready and "READY!" or Cfg.fmtTime(left)
            if p.text.Text ~= text then p.text.Text = text end
            if p.ready ~= ready then
                p.ready = ready
                setGrad(p.text, ready and READY_GRAD or CLOCK_GRAD)
            end
            local tier = model:GetAttribute("EggTier")
            if p.tier ~= tier then
                p.tier = tier
                p.title.Text = tierTitle(model)
                setGrad(p.title, TIER_GRAD[tonumber(tier) or 1] or TIER_GRAD[1])
            end
            local root = model.PrimaryPart
            if root then fitPlate(p, (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude) end

            local owner = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
            if owner ~= nil and owner ~= plr.UserId then
                local pp = model.PrimaryPart
                local pr = pp and pp:FindFirstChild("Hatch")
                if pr and pr.Enabled then pr.Enabled = false end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function keyText(prompt, inputType)
    if inputType == Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Gamepad then
        return (prompt.GamepadKeyCode.Name:gsub("^Button", ""))
    elseif inputType == Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Touch then
        return "TAP"
    end
    local ok, s = pcall(function() return UIS:GetStringForKeyCode(prompt.KeyboardKeyCode) end)
    if not ok or type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then s = prompt.KeyboardKeyCode.Name end
    return s:upper()
end

local function promptLabel(parent, font, size, colour, strokeW, strokeAlpha)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Font = font
    t.TextSize = size
    t.TextColor3 = colour
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    t.Text = ""
    t.Parent = parent
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    s.Thickness = strokeW
    s.Transparency = strokeAlpha
    s.Parent = t
    return t
end

local KEY = 52
local HOLD_COLOUR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local KEY_TEXT_X = KEY + 12
local PROMPT_W, PROMPT_H = 300, 60
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

local function buildPrompt(prompt, inputType)
    local part = prompt.Parent
    if not (part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil end

    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = "EggPrompt"
    bb.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.LightInfluence = 0
    bb.Active = true
    bb.ResetOnSpawn = false

    bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PROMPT_W, PROMPT_H)
    bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0, math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) * 0.6 + 0.4)
    bb.Adornee = part
    bb.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local root = Instance.new("Frame")
    root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PROMPT_W, PROMPT_H)
    root.Parent = bb
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Parent = root

    local key = Instance.new("Frame")
    key.Name = "Key"
    key.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    key.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
    key.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(KEY, KEY)
    key.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 60, 68)
    key.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    key.BorderSizePixel = 0
    key.Parent = root
    Instance.new("UICorner", key).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)

    local setRing = function() end
    if prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
        key.ZIndex = 3
        key.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        local RING = KEY + 10
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.Name = "HoldRing"
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, KEY / 2, 0.5, 0)
        holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RING, RING)
        holder.ZIndex = 1
        holder.Parent = root

        local track = Instance.new("Frame")
        track.Name = "Track"
        track.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
        track.BorderSizePixel = 0
        track.ZIndex = 1
        track.Parent = holder
        Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)

        local function half(isRight)
            local clip = Instance.new("Frame")
            clip.Name = isRight and "Right" or "Left"
            clip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            clip.ClipsDescendants = true
            clip.Position = UDim2.fromScale(isRight and 0.5 or 0, 0)
            clip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
            clip.ZIndex = 2
            clip.Parent = holder
            local disc = Instance.new("Frame")
            disc.BackgroundColor3 = HOLD_COLOUR
            disc.BorderSizePixel = 0
            disc.Position = UDim2.fromScale(isRight and -1 or 0, 0)
            disc.Size = UDim2.fromScale(2, 1)
            disc.ZIndex = 2
            disc.Parent = clip
            Instance.new("UICorner", disc).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)

            local solidLeft = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.501, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            })
            local solidRight = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.501, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
            })
            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Transparency = isRight and solidLeft or solidRight
            g.Parent = disc
            return g
        end
        local rightGrad, leftGrad = half(true), half(false)

        setRing = function(p)
            local deg = math.clamp(p, 0, 1) * 360
            rightGrad.Rotation = math.min(deg, 180)
            leftGrad.Rotation = math.max(deg - 180, 0)
        end
        setRing(0)
    end

    local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
    ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -18)
    ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ring.ZIndex = 2
    ring.Parent = key
    Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.3, 0)
    local ringEdge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    ringEdge.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
    ringEdge.Thickness = 2
    ringEdge.Parent = ring

    local letter = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    letter.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    letter.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    letter.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    letter.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
    letter.Text = keyText(prompt, inputType)
    letter.TextSize = (#letter.Text > 1) and 11 or 17
    letter.ZIndex = 3
    letter.Parent = ring

    local object = promptLabel(root, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 16, Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 212), 1.5, 0.45)
    object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(KEY_TEXT_X, 6)
    object.Size = UDim2.new(1, -KEY_TEXT_X, 0, 20)

    local action = promptLabel(root, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 23, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 2, 0.25)
    action.Size = UDim2.new(1, -KEY_TEXT_X, 0, 28)

    local function refresh()
        object.Text = prompt.ObjectText
        action.Text = prompt.ActionText
        local two = prompt.ObjectText ~= ""
        object.Visible = two
        action.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(KEY_TEXT_X, two and 26 or 16)

        local wide = TextService:GetTextSize(prompt.ActionText, 23, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Vector2.new(1000, 100)).X
        if two then
            wide = math.max(wide, TextService:GetTextSize(prompt.ObjectText, 16, Enum.Font.GothamBold, Vector2.new(1000, 100)).X)
        end
        root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(PROMPT_W, KEY_TEXT_X + math.ceil(wide) + 4), PROMPT_H)
    end
    refresh()

    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    button.Text = ""
    button.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    button.ZIndex = 5
    button.Parent = root
    if prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
        button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() prompt:InputHoldBegin() end)
        button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
        button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
    else
        button.Activated:Connect(function()
            prompt:InputHoldBegin()
            prompt:InputHoldEnd()
        end)
    end

    scale.Scale = 0.6
    TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Scale = 1 }):Play()

    local function bump()
        scale.Scale = 0.85
        TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = 1 }):Play()
    end
    local progress = Instance.new("NumberValue")
    progress.Changed:Connect(setRing)
    local holdTween
    local function hold(on)
        if holdTween then holdTween:Cancel() holdTween = nil end
        progress.Value = 0
        if on and prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
            holdTween = TweenService:Create(progress,
                TweenInfo.new(prompt.HoldDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Value = 1 })
            holdTween:Play()
        end
    end
    local function destroy()
        if holdTween then holdTween:Cancel() holdTween = nil end
        progress:Destroy()
    end
    return { gui = bb, refresh = refresh, bump = bump, hold = hold, destroy = destroy }
end

PPS.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt, inputType)
    if prompt.Style ~= Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom or not prompt:GetAttribute("EggPrompt") then
        return
    end
    local ui = buildPrompt(prompt, inputType)
    if not ui then return end
    local conns = {}
    local function cleanup()
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(conns)
        if ui.gui then ui.gui:Destroy() end
        if ui.destroy then ui.destroy() end
    end
    table.insert(conns, prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ActionText"):Connect(ui.refresh))
    table.insert(conns, prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ObjectText"):Connect(ui.refresh))
    table.insert(conns, prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
        ui.hold(false)
        ui.bump()
    end))
    table.insert(conns, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function() ui.hold(true) end))
    table.insert(conns, prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function() ui.hold(false) end))
    table.insert(conns, prompt.PromptHidden:Connect(cleanup))
    table.insert(conns, prompt.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
end)

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local STEAL_TAG = "StealPrompt"

local function carrying()
    return plr:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") == true
end

local function syncSteal(pr)
    if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then pr.Enabled = not carrying() end
end

local function syncAllSteal()
    for _, pr in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(STEAL_TAG)) do syncSteal(pr) end
end

plr:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CarryingEgg"):Connect(syncAllSteal)
syncAllSteal()
